meaning: To drink slowly, a little at a time.
example: She sipped her coffee and watched the rain.
note_say: One syllable, with a short i sound, like in sit. Not seep.
mean_say: to drink slowly, a little at a time.
ex_say: She sipped her coffee, and watched the rain.
tip: It's also a noun: "take a sip". Short "i", not "seep".
note: One syllable. A short "i" like in "sit", not "seep".
tip_say: It's also a noun: take a sip.
vn_tip: Đừng nuốt âm /p/ cuối: khép môi lại khi kết thúc “sip”.
vn_tip_say: Don't swallow the P at the end. Close your lips to finish: sip.
